rules.description: State interface/type must be explicitly defined, not inferred from initialState
State mutations must use spread operators or Immer (no direct property assignment outside Immer context)
Sync reducers must not contain async/await or network calls — use createAsyncThunk
Selectors returning derived arrays/objects must be wrapped in createSelector
Redux slice actions must be destructured and exported
Redux slice must default-export the reducer for store composition
Do not import store directly in components — use useSelector/useStore hooks
